WHY THIS NEEDS SUBSTANTIAL AI PROCESSING

Real work creates
a recurring workload.

A property portfolio contains long agreements, repeated amendments and changing obligations. The AI must find the relevant clause and check whether a later document changes its meaning.

Planning scenario · not current customer usageEvery lease, amendment and portfolio review
472,500document pages / month
3,375lease briefs in this scenario
140pages per lease pack
75 organizations×45 lease packs per team / month×1 review per changed pack×140 pages per lease pack

Each new pack requires a detailed read and cross-document check. Portfolio reviews repeat the work for changed agreements and approaching obligations.

Estimated monthly volume472,500 document pages236,250,000 input tokens, assuming 500 per page

These are explicit assumptions for evaluating the product idea. Actual usage, model billing and performance need measurement. Unchanged inputs should be cached rather than processed again.

THE WORKING MVP

A review workflow
with clear boundaries.

The public website demonstrates the product using prepared inputs and reports. The repository also includes a server adapter for running real AI analysis with a configured service.

01

Available in the website

Choose two cases, run the prepared analysis, inspect cited evidence, accept a report for review and download it. The dashboard also supports operational notes, status changes, search, filtering and CSV export.

02

Connected AI analysis

The included Node server calls an AI provider with your text and optional images. It asks for a structured report with source references. Configure the API key on the server; no key is embedded in this public website.

03

Repeated processing

The adapter caches identical input for a limited period. New or changed evidence produces a new analysis. Published workload totals are planning arithmetic, not actual customer traffic.

04

Human judgment

It supports lease administration. Legal interpretation, contractual notices and commercial decisions require the appointed professional.

05

Before operating commercially

Connect the real source systems, implement verified accounts and organization access, evaluate the model on representative inputs and define how operators handle uncertain results.
